mapper.sql: id, content, emoji, color, tag, nickname, is_approved, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM moments WHERE is_visible = 1 AND is_approved = 1 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM moments WHERE is_visible = 1 AND is_approved = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM moments WHERE visitor_id = #{visitorId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moments (content, emoji, color, tag, visitor_id, nickname, is_approved, is_visible, ip, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{content}, #{emoji}, #{color}, #{tag}, #{visitorId}, #{nickname}, #{isApproved}, #{isVisible}, #{ip}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE moments SET is_approved = #{isApproved}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
